The scenario is: My coworker kept calling me late at night, so I screamed at her that she had to stop or I would block her number. So, considering all this, I think the action is not morally acceptable because it involves aggression, even if the provocation was there. There are better ways to handle the situation, like calmly asking the coworker to stop calling late or blocking the number without confrontation.
